result.title: Hindsight-Privileged RLVR: Single-Rollout Token Credit Without Group Sampling
result.summary: Reinforcement learning with verifiable rewards (RLVR) trains language models from checked task outcomes, but assigning a terminal reward to individual reasoning tokens or actions remains difficult. Group-relative methods such as Group Relative Policy Optimization (GRPO) sample several attempts per prompt, but lose their reward-based learning signal when all attempts receive the same outcome. We propose Hindsight-Privileged RLVR (HP-RLVR), a single-rollout method that turns a completed trajectory's own future into token-level update weights. The generating policy snapshot scores each eligible token under its causal history and under a hindsight context containing the realized future and verifier feedback. A normalized Jensen--Shannon divergence between the two views weights the reward relative to a historical baseline, yielding bounded token credit for both successful and failed attempts, with no reference solution or learned critic. In paired Qwen3-8B runs over a shared $100$-step schedule, HP-RLVR trains $1.21\times$, $1.46\times$, and $2.30\times$ faster than GRPO on mathematics, code generation, and ALFWorld, using one eighth the rollouts per prompt. Accuracy is comparable overall, with HP-RLVR ahead on mathematics at all three sizes and GRPO ahead on code and ALFWorld. In ALFWorld, $43.2\%$ (4B) and $49.0\%$ (8B) of GRPO's gradient-norm records are zero, versus none for HP-RLVR.

AI.brief_summary: 提出 HP-RLVR：一种单次 rollout 的 RLVR 方法，用同一轨迹的因果历史视角与「事后视角」（含已实现未来和验证器反馈）之间的归一化 Jensen–Shannon 散度，为每个 token 生成有界信用权重，无需参考解或 critic，在数学、代码和 ALFWorld 上以更少 rollout 达到与 GRPO 相当的准确率。
AI.relevance_reason: 其 token 级信用分配与「失败轨迹也有梯度信号」的设计，可能为 LVR 中 latent 轨迹的贡献分配、奖励稀疏和 GRPO 全同结果导致的零信号问题提供可核查的训练线索；但原文为纯文本任务，未涉及视觉状态。
